Python code:

from Bio.PDB import PDBParser
import numpy as np
import requests

url = "https://files.rcsb.org/download/5WB7.pdb"
r = requests.get(url)
r.raise_for_status()
with open("/tmp/5WB7.pdb", "wb") as f:
    f.write(r.content)

parser = PDBParser(QUIET=True)
structure = parser.get_structure("5wb7", "/tmp/5WB7.pdb")
atoms = list(structure.get_atoms())
coord1 = atoms[0].get_coord()
coord2 = atoms[1].get_coord()
dist = np.linalg.norm(coord1 - coord2)
print(f"Distance between the first and second atoms: {round(dist, 3):.3f} Å")
